items.t: Shed fire spreads to nearby mobile home, boat, pickup truck in Citrus County
items.x: Firefighters are investigating after responding to a spreading structure fire in Homosassa Saturday night.

items.t: 2 sheds destroyed, mobile home damaged in Homosassa fire: CCFR
items.x: Two sheds were destroyed and a mobile home, boat and pickup truck were damaged in a fire Saturday night in Homosassa, according to Citrus County Fire Rescue (CCFR).

items.t: Milwaukee still loves him, but Freddy Peralta will try beating the Brewers in World Series Game 3
items.x: Freddy Peralta spent his first eight major league seasons trying to help the Milwaukee Brewers earn the World Series berth that continually eluded them.

items.t: Jeep reported stolen in 2023 pulled from retention pond: SPPD
items.x: St. Pete police say the Jeep was reported stolen in 2023.

items.t: 5 men sentenced in Ybor City nightclub armed robbery
items.x: The men drove across the state with plans to steal from the club. The owner of the club was shot in the face by one man.

items.t: Pasco woman arrested after dead animals found in home: affidavit
items.x: Deputies say they found the bodies of a dog and cat that both appeared to be "partially consumed."

items.t: Ric Flair shares health update amid blood clot treatment, fall
items.x: Wrestling icon Ric Flair shared a health update Saturday after he said he was dealing with a blood clot in his leg and had a fall.

items.t: Dmitri Simashev scores his second goal in OT as Mammoth beat Lightning 5-4
items.x: Dmitri Simashev scored his second goal of the game at 1:44 of overtime as the Utah Mammoth beat the Tampa Bay Lightning 5-4 on Saturday night.

items.t: Dead pets found in Pasco County home without electricity; woman arrested
items.x: A woman was arrested after deputies said she knowingly and intentionally neglected several animals inside her home.

items.t: 2 dead, driver arrested after 30-person Halloween bike ride struck in California
items.x: Two people are dead after a driver allegedly struck a group of roughly 30 bicyclists participating in a Halloween ride in California.

items.t: 10 Tampa Bay Weather: Breezy conditions continue with increasing rain chances this week
items.x: Gusty northeast winds will stick around through midweek, with scattered showers becoming more likely as the week progresses.

items.t: Victim's house foreclosed after Pinellas County man defrauds over $30k escrow funds: arrest report
items.x: A man was arrested in Seminole on Monday after deputies said he engaged in a scheme to defraud one person of more than $30,000.

items.t: At least 12 people injured in shooting near a football stadium in Florida
items.x: At least 12 people, including six children, were injured in a shooting near Florida A&M University during homecoming weekend in Tallahassee.

items.t: Bucky Irving runs for 2 TDs and Bucs force 4 turnovers in 43-13 rout of Panthers
items.x: Bucky Irving ran for 106 yards and two touchdowns, and Tampa Bay forced four turnovers as the Buccaneers hammered the Carolina Panthers 43-13 on Sunday in Baker Mayfield’s return.

items.t: Venezuela's opposition leader Machado returns after months in exile, as doubts over democracy deepen
items.x: Opposition leader María Corina Machado reappeared in Venezuela Sunday for the first time since December, returning from exile at a time when doubts about the country's democratic future.

items.t: Drew Rasmussen can't make it through 4th inning as Rays blow 4-0 lead in Game 2 loss to Brewers
items.x: Tampa Bay Rays ace Drew Rasmussen had sailed through his first three postseason starts while working at least six innings in each of them.

items.t: Could this be the best time to buy a home? Sellers cut prices and offer cash to close deals
items.x: Homebuyers are gaining leverage as a stagnant housing market leaves sellers cutting prices and offering money toward closing costs.

items.t: Alaska Democratic Senate candidate Mary Peltola and her family suffer minor injuries in car crash
items.x: Alaska's Democratic Senate candidate Mary Peltola and her family suffered minor injuries Saturday in a car crash while driving to a campaign stop, her campaign said.

items.t: Rays World Series home games: Parking, traffic, tickets and stadium information
items.x: World Series baseball is coming to Tropicana Field, and Rays fans are getting ready to pack the ballpark for the team’s home games.
